scenario: LSER.10.9 / LSER.17.2: `direction` returns an `Int?` -- `-1`, `0` or `+1` -- and is `null` while cold and over one sample. Drives the companion read `s.direction` of a `sliding` declaration through typecheck (an `Int` compared with `>= -1`, which a String-typed read cannot satisfy statically) and the series read path, the raw-sample backing (SeriesBackendRingBuffer) in both runtimes. Values 10, 20, 30, one per pump, each read pre-sample (LSER.8.6.1): the first read is cold and the second sees one sample, and both are `null`, so the guard holds neither and nothing logs; the third sees [10, 20], rising, and logs 1.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    dev: String key
    level: Int mutable

series Reading.level (by: dev):
    direction sliding 1_h

rule r:
    Reading s where s.direction is not null and s.direction >= -1
->
    log info "direction {s.direction}"
